name: theme-selection
body: `theme` is optional and deck-wide only (never per slide); omitted = `default`. Available themes are exactly the directories under the project's `templates/themes/`; there are no built-in themes. A named (or defaulted) theme that the project does not define = error listing the project's available themes with a closest-match suggestion. The theme mechanism remains a registry so themes are added by adding a directory, without template changes.
